description: Estimates an agency's accounts per account manager, yearly coordination cost, and how many more accounts the same team could carry at a target ratio. Use when the user shares client and team numbers and asks about capacity, hiring, or account manager load. Returns an estimate, not a guarantee.

account_managers.description: People who own client accounts day to day.

avg_monthly_retainer.description: Average monthly retainer per client in USD. Optional.

hours_lost_per_am_per_week.description: Hours each account manager loses per week to re-briefing AI, chasing approvals, fixing work and reporting. Optional.

loaded_hourly_cost.description: Loaded hourly cost of an account manager in USD. Optional.

target_accounts_per_am.description: Target accounts per account manager. Default 18.

name: capacity_check
title: Agency capacity check
